# python-1.24.0

## What Changed

[1.24.0] 2026 10 30 [!WARNING] Redis context index migration: The beta RedisContextProvider now preserves exact scope identity and rejects the legacy raw scope index schema. Delete the old context index and its context hashes, let the provider create a new index, and re ingest the context data. overwrite index=True does not migrate incompatible indexes. [!IMPORTANT] Python support: Python 3.11 or later is now the supported baseline, subject to package specific upper limits. Python 3.10 installation remains permitted by Requires Python in this release, but compatibility is not guaranteed. The next release will also remove Python 3.10 installation eligibility from Requires Python . Upgrade to Python 3.11 or later as soon as possible.
